# clidraw

> clidraw is a full-screen terminal whiteboard. Draw with the mouse on an infinite canvas. Agents use its MCP server to read and edit canvases.

## Install

Run one of these commands:

- Shell: `curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/shortcuts/clidraw/releases/latest/download/clidraw-installer.sh | sh`
- PowerShell: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://github.com/shortcuts/clidraw/releases/latest/download/clidraw-installer.ps1 | iex"`
- Homebrew: `brew install shortcuts/tap/clidraw`
- mise: `mise use -g github:shortcuts/clidraw`
- Cargo: `cargo install clidraw`

Check the install with `clidraw --version`.

## MCP setup

Run `claude mcp add clidraw -- clidraw mcp` for Claude Code, or `codex mcp add clidraw -- clidraw mcp` for Codex.

For other MCP clients, add this entry to the `mcpServers` object of the client config:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clidraw": {
      "command": "clidraw",
      "args": ["mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Close the canvas in the clidraw window before an agent edits it.

## Docs

- [Install](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/install.html): every install method and the terminal requirements
- [Use with agents](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/agents.html): MCP setup for each client
- [Getting Started](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/index.html): draw the first diagram
- [Configuration](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/config.html): config file options
- [Key bindings](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/keys.html): every key
- [Command line](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/cli.html): every command and its output
- [MCP tools](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/mcp.html): every MCP tool and its parameters
- [Draw a flowchart](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/draw-a-flowchart.html): shapes, labels and layout
- [Import Mermaid](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/import-mermaid.html): turn Mermaid text into shapes
- [Export SVG](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/export-svg.html): export a drawing as SVG, or copy a link that draws it in the browser
- [Manage canvases](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/manage-canvases.html): create, switch, rename and delete canvases
- [Scope and design choices](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/scope.html): what clidraw does and does not do
- [Where files live](https://clidraw.shrtcts.fr/where-files-live.html): where canvas files are stored
